usedFor: SandeshChat holds inbound messages, and Google Contacts stores the sender through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Inbound Message Arrives” in SandeshChat, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A new sender is saved as a contact, so you can find them later.

watchOut: “Update Contact” merges new details with existing fields, so check what “New Inbound Message Arrives” passes.
